reason: In the patch's embeddable-host component save() (change.patch:57), host.category is set from Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')). categoryId starts as null (change.patch:28) and stays null for a new host when the admin leaves the category chooser on its default Uncategorized option. Meanwhile the server replaces a blank category_id with uncategorized_category_id (change.patch:274), so the client gets an undefined category and the badge shows blank until reload.
